name: no-individual-residence
description: Norwegian tax residence of individuals for income year 2026: arrival, emigration and the cross-border consequences. Covers the 183 days in 12 months and 270 days in 36 months presence tests in skatteloven § 2-1, when residence starts, emigration under the 61-day and no-home conditions, the three-year tail for people resident ten years or more, the home and family definitions and the five-year holiday-home exception, wealth tax liability on 31 December, global versus limited liability (§ 2-3), the one-year foreign work relief, the foreign tax credit, the exit tax on shares above NOK 3 million with 12-year deferral, treaty residence, return deadlines and additional tax. Trigger on: Norway tax residence, skattemessig bosatt, emigrate from Norway, 183 days Norway, 61 days rule, ten-year rule, exit tax Norway, utflyttingsskatt, ettårsregelen.
